QUOTE: "It is the only library code that calls the setter."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` installs its own allocator via `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free` and is the only library code that calls the setter. It doesn't name `MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C`, but the file and init function identify the buffer allocator.
